title: acer campestre f. pulverulentum
intro: Acer campestre f. pulverulentum, commonly known as Field Maple, is a plant species that belongs to the family Sapindaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to soothe digestive issues and alleviate stress. The therapeutic actions of Field Maple include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for traditional medicine.
